Culture

Between the mountain and the sea, there is a way of welcoming.

The tais, the traditional cloth woven in Timor-Leste.

In Liquiçá, hospitality is part of the place. Lauhata brings together flavours, landscape and the calm of the Timorese coast.

Frequently asked questions

Before you book

How do I make a booking?

Fill in the table or room form and send the message that opens in WhatsApp. The Lauhata team replies in that conversation.

Is my booking confirmed as soon as I send it?

No. The form prepares a request. The table or room is only booked once Lauhata confirms availability with you.

How do I find out the room price?

The final price depends on the dates and room type, and Lauhata tells you in their reply to your request.

Do I have to pay anything on the website?

No. The website takes no payments. Any payment terms are agreed directly with Lauhata.

Where is Lauhata?

In Lauhata, in the municipality of Liquiçá, west of Dili. The contact page has the map and directions.
